case.symptom: Customers who ask for two orders back in one message sometimes get one refund or none, and the reply says a person will follow up.

suspects.subject: Add a get_order_status tool for where-is-my-order questions
Add agent version to the run_info span, read from pyproject.toml
Add a troubleshooting section to the refund-agent README
Prefix failed tool call stderr line with a timestamp
Warm up the refund agent's system prompt
Give customers the benefit of the doubt on small details
Acknowledge the problem first and offer refund or replacement where it fits
Keep refund agent from naming other customers when it can't help
Require a reason on every refund and cut model calls to save on gateway spend
Report model_calls in --json output for cost tracking
Hoist tool registry in call_tool to module-level TOOL_FUNCTIONS
Refresh refund-agent README's list of changes from the neatroots example
Catch invalid JSON in tool call arguments instead of crashing the run
Show an example --json line in refund-agent README
